headline: Chiefs defense stops the Colts
what_happened: The Colts passed for five yards, but it was not enough to get a first down, which is a new set of four chances to move the ball.
who: D.Jones passed to K.Allen, but K.Fulton made the stop for the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is good news for the Chiefs as they continue to lead 27-20. By stopping the Colts on this play, the Chiefs slightly increased their chances of winning the game.
